changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwAvailabilityGenerationBatch AS SELECT a.id, a.template_id, a.scope, a.apply_start_date_time, a.apply_end_date_time, a.total_slots, a.daily_avg, a.execution_status, a.holiday_handling_mode, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date, a.interval_ended_notification_sent, a.interval_ended_notification_sent_at FROM public.availability_generation_batch a;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwAvailabilityGenerationBatch TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON report.availability_generation_batch FROM report_user;
